name: Ofir Eliasi
description: Ofir Eliasi has over twenty years of engineering experience and has been a CTO and founder multiple times over in the blockchain space. He specializes in blockchain infrastructure, account abstraction, DeFi, protocol security, cross-chain interoperability, and on-chain payment rails. He has led development at Lava Network, Kerberus, SSV, Biconomy, and others.
